AI agent guides

AI Agent Skills

Writing Published Feluqa Documentation

On this page

AI Agent Skills ​

This guide collects reusable skills for AI agents working on Feluqa. Each skill describes a focused workflow for a recurring task, such as changing documentation or validating a subsystem.

Skills supplement applicable project instructions and relevant product or technical guides. They do not override those instructions, change the implementation status of a feature, or replace required review and validation.

Local documentation rules ​

An agent may keep local rules, working notes, and planning documents in a .x-agents/ directory at the root of its working area:

text
<working-area-root>/.x-agents/RULES.md
<working-area-root>/.x-agents/<other-local-file-or-folder>/

For example, the working root for this guide collection is docs/guides/feluqa.rs/, so its local agent material belongs in docs/guides/feluqa.rs/.x-agents/. Put shared local conventions in RULES.md; use additional portable Markdown files for focused rules, working notes, and plans. Add the path to the working repository's .gitignore so these local files are not committed or published as guide pages. Keep canonical, reader-facing product and technical guidance in the published documentation tree. Follow the project owner's instructions when material is intended to be shared.

Documentation for the published site ​

Write documentation as standalone site content. Do not link to local source files using relative paths; refer instead to files distributed with source code or to product resources, and describe unavailable resources as planned.

Available skills ​

  • Writing Published Feluqa Documentation: preserve product intent, use the canonical taxonomy, keep site content independent of local source files, and distinguish product direction from delivered behavior.

Add a skill when a task has a repeatable workflow that benefits from dedicated instructions; keep general project rules in AGENTS.md and link to them instead of copying them into every skill.
